title: Funky Ehh
blurb: A groove, a grunt, and somehow an entire wave of dance edits. What makes this one work is that the ehh stops being a vocal noise and becomes a percussion instrument — it lands on the beat, it carries the rhythm, and your brain files it alongside a snare rather than a voice. That is the internet's core talent in miniature: taking something meaningless and building a functioning trend on top of it. Silly, danceable, and impossible to hear once without nodding along to at least part of it.
origin: A viral dance-edit sound built around a rhythmic 'ehh'.
